name: Tesamorelin
effects: Stabilized GHRH analogue (trans-3-hexenoic acid conjugate) — FDA-approved for HIV-associated lipodystrophy (2010)
Approved dose: 2 mg SC once daily
Reduces visceral abdominal fat by ~15–20% over 26 weeks in clinical trials
Raises IGF-1 and GH; cardioprotective lipid changes secondary to VAT reduction
Fluid retention, arthralgia, carpal tunnel syndrome at higher doses
Contraindicated in pregnancy; disrupts HPA axis if used with glucocorticoids
Off-label use for metabolic syndrome / body composition — compounded versions available
